reasons.plausibility: Adding a small amount of Hf to form strengthening precipitates in a refractory HEA is scientifically justified, but the magnitude of the claimed improvements leaves some uncertainty.
reasons.testability: A clear side-by-side comparison of Hf-doped and undoped alloys with well-defined mechanical tests provides a strong, straightforward way to confirm or refute the mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It proposes a targeted, practical alloy modification for simultaneously improving high-temperature strength and ductility while preserving density and room-temperature properties.
